decisions.evidence: r3 maker: 'paste (or type) a link ... press Save. Watch what happens to it in the list'; r3 client accepts 'The one-box-at-the-top layout feels right'.
decisions.note: Prototype review. Save-by-url presented and accepted; conforms to reference. Not a divergence.

decisions.evidence: r3 maker: auto-fill takes 'basic details' to mean 'a readable title and the site name automatically'. r3 client: 'The automatic details are a bit too limited ... I'd expect the page title, a short description, the actual site icon, and a preview image ... not just the site name and an initial.'
decisions.note: Prototype review. Presented metadata set (title+site name) diverges from REF-BM-02 (title, description, favicon, preview image). Client supplies the reference-conforming set = correct.

decisions.evidence: r3 maker presentation shows only auto-fill+save, no editing. r3 client: 'I'd also want to be able to correct the title or description before finishing the save, as well as edit them later.' Confirmed r4 by maker's review-before-save card + Edit button.
decisions.note: Prototype review. Editing before/after save (REF-BM-03/04) was absent from presented scope; client requests the missing reference requirement = extend.

decisions.evidence: r4 maker: saved card shows 'preview image, title, description, site icon + name, and the link — newest at the top'. r4 client: 'the saved cards are readable.'
decisions.note: Prototype review. Readability-first list exposing title/description/tags/favicon conforms to REF-BM-07.

decisions.evidence: r6 maker presents tag entry (pills); r6 client: 'I like seeing each tag as a removable pill'. Multiple tags per bookmark shown.
decisions.note: Prototype review. Assigning one or more tags (REF-BM-09) presented and accepted; conforms.

decisions.evidence: r6 maker offers tag entry A (type+Enter), B (comma field), C (suggest previously-used tags). Only C offers autocomplete of existing tags. r6 client: 'Option C feels best ... with matching tags I've used before suggested as I type.'
decisions.note: Prototype review. Offered alternatives differ in fulfilment of REF-BM-10 (autocomplete of existing tags); A/B lack it. Client selects the conforming alternative (C) = select; decision marked diverged=true.

decisions.evidence: r6 maker presents note as 'a separate field ... shown on the saved card' with no formatting. r6 client: 'I'd like notes to support simple formatting—such as headings, lists, links, and emphasis—and display that formatting when I view the bookmark.'
decisions.note: Prototype review. Markdown/formatted note rendering (REF-BM-23) missing from presented plain-note scope; client requests the reference requirement = extend. Delivered r7 as live-preview markdown.

decisions.evidence: r6 maker presents adding tags/note at save time, not later editing of them. r6 client: 'Tags and the note should also be editable later, alongside the title and description.' Confirmed r7 maker: 'tags and the note will both be editable later'.
decisions.note: Prototype review. Later editing of tags/note (part of REF-BM-04) not in presented scope; client extends. Distinct from earlier title/description editing decision, at a later point.

decisions.evidence: r8 maker searches 'title, tags, note, description, and the site'. r8 client: 'Please include the full web address too, not only the site name'. r9 maker: 'the full web address is now searched and shown'.
decisions.note: Specification/prototype review. Presented search covered site name but not full url; REF-BM-12 requires url. Client supplies the conforming behaviour = correct.

decisions.evidence: r8 maker makes no statement about case handling. r8 client: 'make searching insensitive to capitalization.' r9 maker: 'all matching is case-insensitive.'
decisions.note: Prototype review. Case-insensitive search (REF-BM-13) absent from presented scope; client requests missing requirement = extend.

decisions.evidence: r8 maker presents single-box full-text search only. r8 client: '#focus should search specifically for the "focus" tag'. r9 maker demonstrates '#focus' tag search.
decisions.note: Prototype review. #tag search syntax (REF-BM-14) missing from presented scope; client extends.

decisions.evidence: r8 maker: no tag-click filtering presented. r8 client: 'clicking a tag should show only bookmarks with that tag.' r9 maker: clicking a pill fills '#recipes' and narrows list.
decisions.note: Prototype review. Select-a-tag-to-filter (REF-BM-11) missing from presented scope; client extends.

decisions.evidence: r8 maker presents no phrase matching. r8 client: 'Quoted words should match that exact phrase.' r9 maker: '"read later" ... matches only where those two words appear together'.
decisions.note: Prototype review. Exact quoted-phrase match (REF-BM-16) missing from presented scope; client extends.

decisions.evidence: r8 maker presents no boolean logic. r8 client: 'combine terms with AND, OR, NOT, and parentheses—for example, rome (#article OR #book) ... those words should only act as instructions when unquoted; "OR" should search for the literal word.' r9 maker demonstrates grouping, NOT, and quoted-operator-literal.
decisions.note: Prototype review. Boolean/parenthesised query language incl. quoted-operator-as-literal (REF-BM-15) missing from presented scope; client extends with the exact reference rule.

decisions.evidence: r10 maker presents To read/Finished views with 'Mark finished' / 'Move to To read'. r10/r11 client accepts; 'marking it finished should remove it from that view, and moving it back should restore it.'
decisions.note: Prototype review. Read-later flag, separate unread view, and mark-read (REF-BM-17/18/19) presented and accepted; arrangement choice (A/B/C) and default landing are functionally equivalent/orthogonal, not divergences.

decisions.evidence: r12 maker offers a choice: 'Should archived bookmarks still turn up when you search? ... exclude them ... or still find them.' r12 client: 'Archived bookmarks should not appear in ordinary searches. Searching from the Archived view itself should search only archived bookmarks.'
decisions.note: Prototype review. Offered alternatives differ in fulfilment of REF-BM-26 / edge rule (archived hidden from ordinary search). Client selects the conforming alternative = select; diverged=true on the offered decision.

decisions.evidence: r12 maker presents Archive only (no delete). r12 client: 'I also need a clearly separate Delete action for permanent removal, with a confirmation so it isn't confused with the reversible Archive action.' r13 maker adds distinct red Delete with confirm.
decisions.note: Prototype review. Permanent delete (REF-BM-05) and its distinction from reversible archive (REF-BM-27) missing from presented scope; client requests the missing reference requirements = extend.

decisions.evidence: r14 maker: on duplicate save it 'scrolls to that existing bookmark and highlights it ... no duplicate created.' r14 client: 'finding and highlighting the existing bookmark isn't quite enough. A duplicate save should take me directly to editing that existing bookmark—or give me a clear "Edit existing" action.' r15 maker adds 'Edit existing'.
decisions.note: Prototype review. Presented behaviour (highlight/scroll only) diverges from REF-BM-06 / edge rule (converge to EDITING the existing item). Client supplies the reference-conforming behaviour = correct.

decisions.evidence: r15 maker's Edit-existing form 'shows tags as a comma-separated field and the note as a plain box'. r15 client: 'It should use the tag pills with matching past-tag suggestions and the formatted-note editor with live preview ... exactly like editing the bookmark normally.' r16 maker aligns it.
decisions.note: Prototype review. In the duplicate-edit context the form diverged from REF-BM-10 (tag autocomplete) and REF-BM-23 (markdown note). Same requirements at a later point; client supplies conforming behaviour = correct.

decisions.evidence: r19 maker offers two readings: '(1) newest-first should always apply ... nothing new is needed' vs '(2) choose between different sort orders'. r19 client: 'I meant the second ... Please include newest added, oldest added, recently updated, title A–Z, and title Z–A ... remember my preferred default ... apply consistently to search results and each filtered view.'
decisions.note: Specification gate. Presented state had only fixed newest-first; offered alternatives differ in fulfilment of REF-BM-22. Client selects the multi-sort (conforming) alternative = select. (Remembered default sort links to REF-BM-32, captured at r21.) One decision spanning the r19 clarification and its disposition.

decisions.evidence: r21 maker declares the 10-behaviour scope complete and asks to build. r21 client: 'Not quite yet ... Clicking a bookmark should open its original web page.' r22 maker implements open-in-new-tab.
decisions.note: Specification gate. Navigate-to-original (REF-BM-08) omitted from the maker's declared-complete pre-build scope; client requests the missing reference requirement = extend.

decisions.evidence: r21 client: 'I need to select multiple bookmarks and add or remove tags, mark them read or unread, archive them, or delete them together.' r23 maker implements bulk actions.
decisions.note: Specification gate. Multi-select bulk actions (REF-BM-20) omitted from the declared-complete scope; client extends.

decisions.evidence: r21 client: 'I should also be able to apply an action to every bookmark matching the current search or filter, not merely those loaded on screen.' r23 maker demonstrates 'Select all 137 bookmarks that match #reading'.
decisions.note: Specification gate. Whole-collection (filter-scoped) bulk apply (REF-BM-21) omitted from declared-complete scope; client extends.

decisions.evidence: r21 client: 'I want a preserved local copy of a saved page. For a PDF, preserve the PDF itself; for a normal page, keep a self-contained page copy.' r24 maker implements self-contained copy + PDF preservation.
decisions.note: Specification gate. Local snapshot with PDF-preservation rule (REF-BM-24 + edge rule) omitted from declared-complete scope; client extends with the reference rule.

decisions.evidence: r21 client: 'I'd also like the option to save a copy through the Internet Archive.' r24 maker implements opt-in Internet Archive panel.
decisions.note: Specification gate. Internet Archive snapshot (REF-BM-25) omitted from declared-complete scope; client extends.

decisions.evidence: r21 client: 'I want to save a useful combination of search text plus included or excluded tags as a reusable collection.' r25 maker implements live collections.
decisions.note: Specification gate. Saved bundle/collection (REF-BM-29) omitted from declared-complete scope; client extends.

decisions.evidence: r21 client: 'I need to import existing browser bookmarks ... in the common bookmark HTML format, retaining titles, tags, and original save dates.' r26 maker implements Netscape HTML import.
decisions.note: Specification gate. Netscape HTML import preserving title/tags/date (REF-BM-30) omitted from declared-complete scope; client extends.

decisions.evidence: r21 client: '... and export my library in the common bookmark HTML format, retaining titles, tags, and original save dates.' r26 maker implements standard-format export.
decisions.note: Specification gate. Netscape HTML export (REF-BM-31) omitted from declared-complete scope; client extends.

decisions.evidence: r21 client: 'Along with the remembered default sort, I want personal display choices such as font size and how many items are shown.' r27 maker implements text size, density, items-per-load, default sort.
decisions.note: Specification gate. Display/user settings (REF-BM-32: default sort, displayed items, font size) omitted from declared-complete scope; client extends.

decisions.evidence: r30 maker discloses a 'fidelity note': 'a preserved page copy is saved as a single self-contained HTML file (deeper asset-inlining is a future enhancement)'. r30 client: 'one fidelity note conflicts with an approved behavior ... If parts such as images or styling still depend on the live site, that promise is not met. Please correct the preserved-copy implementation ... This is an implementation fix within the current cycle, not a later enhancement.' r31 maker embeds CSS/images and verifies with origin offline.
decisions.note: Implementation review. Delivered snapshot still depended on the live origin, diverging from REF-BM-24 (genuinely self-contained single-file snapshot). Maker disclosed it as future work; client rejects the departure and demands alignment = corrective/correct.
